diagnostics.message: aws_ecs_cluster_capacity_providers.this must wait for aws_ecs_capacity_provider.this to create the autoscaling capacity providers before associating their names with the cluster. The supplied graph contains no such dependency, and capacity_providers uses input names rather than the created resources. Reference the created capacity providers' names to establish the ordering.

fix.expression: distinct(concat([for k, v in var.fargate_capacity_providers : try(v.name, k)], [for k, v in aws_ecs_capacity_provider.this : v.name]))
